title: Warp section frame
description: The frame every section sits in: a full-width hairline on top with small ink ticks hanging at six column guides, faint vertical guides, a dotted margin outside a plain centre column, and black tabs at both window edges level with the heading. The heading is a typed '# TAG [STATUS]' line, a large mono title with open leading and a muted lead, with an optional button at the right. The content rises 12px and fades in as it enters the window.
notes: the reveal and the typed tag are CSS scroll-driven animations; browsers without them (and reduced motion) show everything in place
tone brand turns the whole band brand-coloured with white dots (for a highlighted section)
also exports WarpGuides, the column guides alone, for blocks that draw their own section
all warp blocks subtract var(--warp-squeeze) from their letter-spacing: 0.1em in the warp theme (its mono runs wide), 0 under other themes
